title: Hardcoded Default Secret Key Fallback in JWT Verification
data_type: SYNTHETIC / DEMONSTRATION DATA - NOT VERIFIED WORLD MONITOR VULNERABILITIES
description: The JWT verification module falls back to a hardcoded string if the environment variable JWT_SECRET is not defined. Attackers can forge administrative tokens using the hardcoded default key.
remediation: Remove the hardcoded fallback secret. Ensure server initialization aborts if JWT_SECRET is missing or under 256 bits of entropy.

title: Missing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) on Telemetry Export API
evidence: router.get('/api/v1/telemetry/export', authenticateToken, (req, res) => { /* exports full DB dump */ });
description: The endpoint checks for a valid authentication token but fails to verify if the authenticated user has administrative privileges, allowing standard users to dump system telemetry.
remediation: Attach an authorization middleware (e.g., `requireRole('admin')`) to the route handler before returning data.

title: Permissive Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) Wildcard Header
description: Wildcard CORS origin combined with credentials allows any third-party website to initiate authenticated cross-origin requests on behalf of legitimate users.
remediation: Restrict Access-Control-Allow-Origin to an explicit whitelist of trusted domains and disallow wildcard origins when credentials are allowed.

title: Verbose Debug Error Messages Leaking Stack Traces to Client
evidence: res.status(500).json({ error: err.message, stack: err.stack, internalContext: err.config });
description: Unhandled server errors leak internal stack traces, system paths, and database query details to HTTP response bodies in production.
remediation: Sanitize HTTP 500 error responses in production environments. Log detailed stack traces internally to secure logger instances only.

title: Unbound Dynamic Database Query Parameter in Log Search API
description: Constructing dynamic MongoDB query code directly from user input allows arbitrary JavaScript code execution in the database engine context.
remediation: Replace dynamic `$where` evaluation with structured parameter queries or parameterized regular expressions.
